mechanism: Expose each CPU shadow tensor once as a NumPy view for unchanged original ranking/floor method ASTs; replace eligible CPU Float32 hysteresis operations with equivalent NumPy array operations. Unsupported dtype/shape/device keeps original. Research-stage helper only; no model prototype.
primary: At least 4 ms lower median charged promotion planning stage; all three ABBA blocks improve and p95 <=2% worse; exact plans/selections, hysteresis bytes and no mutation of shadow/resident/positions.
schedule: Three control/bulk/bulk/control blocks; each arm ten warmup plus twenty measured calls, evenly replaying all ten captured actual steps twice. Clone/reset fixtures and compare results outside both timing arms.
guards: 320 actual layer inputs reproduce captured original decisions. Empty/shadow/floor/hysteresis/nonfinite/subnormal/large float/position-keyed attention/invalid duplicate indices and unsupported Float64/BFloat16 fallback before timing.
progression: If primary or guard fails, stop before model/native/generation/recycling/CLI gates. Only a passed charged stage justifies a preregistered full-model trial; no speed or quality claim from this stage.
